CronullaMorrow

Morrow is a neighbourhood café on Kingsway, two minutes from the beach. Tom and Mia opened it in 2019 to serve the kind of breakfast they wanted on a slow Sunday.

Coffee comes from a small roaster in Caringbah, bread is baked overnight, and the menu changes with whatever is good that week. Pull up a chair, or grab a coffee from the window on your way to the water.

Breakfast,
lunch and coffee

A short menu cooked properly. Breakfast all morning, lunch from eleven, and a counter of pastries that usually sells out before ten on weekends.

The back
room

Birthdays, christenings, team breakfasts and long Sunday lunches. The back room seats up to 30, or you can take over the whole café after 3pm.

Tell us the date, the headcount and what you have in mind, and we will put a menu together.
